auth.refresh_credential_required.message: This action requires the refresh credential in the X-Yuruna-Refresh-Credential header; a lab session, lab token or internal authentication key is not accepted.
auth.refresh_credential_required.description: Refusal from the host refresh credential gate when the request does not carry the operator refresh credential in its dedicated header; returned as HTTP 401 or as an MCP refusal. Preserve the header name X-Yuruna-Refresh-Credential exactly.

auth.refresh_throttled.message: Too many refresh credential attempts from this address; wait {minutes} minutes and try again.
auth.refresh_throttled.description: Refusal from the host refresh credential gate (extension-sdk hostrefresh gate) after repeated wrong credentials from one source address; returned as HTTP 429 or as an MCP refusal.

auth.refresh_unconfigured.message: Remote host refresh is disabled: this service has no refresh credential provisioned.
auth.refresh_unconfigured.description: Refusal from the host refresh credential gate (extension-sdk hostrefresh gate) when the service holds no operator refresh credential; returned as HTTP 503 or as an MCP refusal. The credential and header names are protocol terms; keep them.
